schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. reviewMethod: Every paper page and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; every symbol-font span and every Calibri-Bold list mark of the scheme audited against the rendered page; each reading prompt, scheme slice, tariff and literature line is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading (2013: Léamhthuiscint A and B both compulsory): all twelve questions of both passages are carded as whole questions; each printed part is also a practice card at its published tariff. A 1(a) (“{3 mharc: 2 mharc+1 mharc}”), A 3(a) (“{3 mharc} … {2 mharc +1mharc}”), A 5(a) and B 4(a) (“{3 mharc, 2 mharc +1 mharc}”) and both 6(a) stay whole as 0/2/3 (A 3(a) also prints a deficient answer at 1); A 2(a), A 4(a), B 1(a), 2(a), 3(a) and 5(a) are single “{3 mharc}” answers with the partials the scheme prints (A 2(a): “{3-1 =2 mharc mura mbíonn ach rud amháin luaite.}”).

B 2(b)(ii) prices two groups “{2 mharc, 1 mharc+1 mharc} • Na pobail Ghaeltachta (1 mharc) + Gaeilgeoirí (ar fud na tíre) (1 mharc)” independently: the part allows 0/1/2 and each answer has a one-mark practice slot (as 2015 B 2(b)(i)).

A 6(b) prices two independent six-mark reasons for the candidate’s view (“An mharcáil = 6 mharc +6 mharc; Fáth 1 + Sampla 1 = 6 mharc, Fáth 2 + Sampla 2 = 6 mharc”), each half also a practice slot (as 2017 A 6(b)); the scheme caps a bare retelling at 3 of 6. B 6(b) is the genre 2 and two traits with an example each 5 + 5, which count only with the genre named, so it stays one part (as 2015 B 6(b)). Both must be in the candidate’s own words.

Single-answer parts allow only the mark values the scheme prints for them (0, the printed partials, including deductions printed as “3-1”, “2- 1” or “2-1”, and the full tariff); a 2-mark part whose scheme prints only 2-mark answers allows 0 or 2.

Prose: 2A (Oisín i dTír na nÓg) and 2B (an optional folk tale) each ask for two of three printed headings; the scheme marks the better answer out of 13 and the other out of 12. Each is one card carrying all three headings, with the two Eolas marks and the shared Gaeilge 5 as criteria; no per-heading card, because a heading alone has no printed price. Poetry 3A and 3B and the six Q4 options are one card each; the optional text itself is open content chosen inside one route. 2013 prints no optional film or play.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 Léamhthuiscint 100 (A 50 and B 50: Ceisteanna 1–5 at 7 each, (a) 3 + (b)(i) 2 + (b)(ii) 2; Ceist 6 at 15, (a) 3 + (b) 12); Ceist 2 Prós 30; Ceist 3 Filíocht 30; Ceist 4 Litríocht Bhreise 40 (choose one of 4A–4F). Literature Eolas 25/25/35 plus Gaeilge 5 each.

Reading A is “Steve Jobs: Fiontraí agus Fealsamh” (paper pages 4–5), B “Raidió na Gaeltachta: 40 Bliain ar an Aer” (6–7). The scheme reprints each part before its answers; the cards show the paper’s wording.

Scheme reprints that differ from the paper, kept as printed in the guidance: A 4(b)(ii) “Cén fath ar thug Jobs óráidí?” (paper “fáth”); A 6(b) “Bunaithe ar an eolas atá sa sliocht thuas … Tabhair dhá fhath …” (paper “ar an eolas sa sliocht … dhá fháth”); B 6(b) “den dá threith” (paper “thréith”). Misprints in the scheme’s own text, kept as printed: B 6(b) “Gan an cinéal (genre)”; the B 5(b)(i) answer “tar éis a naoi a chlog trathnóna” (passage “tráthnóna”); B 2(b)(i) is reprinted “Gaeltachta.(Alt 2)”.

The 6(b) panels print the examiner’s score boxes (“F 1 + S 1 (6) =”, “Léiriú: C (2) =”, “Léiriú: T 1 + S 1 (5) =”); they are removed by exact match. B 6(b) ends with the scheme’s list of accepted genres (“• píosa tuairisciúil … • insint / cur síos ar…”), which stays with that part; 2013 prints no list of sample traits.

Literature: the scheme prints no band tables. Each prose answer ends at the examiner’s note “Nóta: Caithfidh an Scrúdaitheoir an marc as 25 (13 + 12) (Ábhar) agus as 5 (Gaeilge) a thaispeáint …”; each poetry answer at “Ní mór don Scrúdaitheoir an marc ar eolas as 25 marc …”. 3A(i) prices “( Eolas = 13 mharc)” and 3A(ii) “Pointe amháin eolais a mharcáil as 5 mharc” with no further split; 3B(i) “Príomhthéama = 3 mharc Cur síos air = 10 marc”; 4F(i) “Príomhthéama an dáin = 2 mharc Léiriú ar an bpríomhthéama = 17 marc”, 4F(ii) “= 8 marc”, 4F(iii) “Fáth 1 = 4 mharc Fáth 2 = 4 mharc”.

General grade table: scheme PDF 28 prints “Grádú Marcála sna Ceisteanna” (an A–D grade-to-mark table for totals 200 down to 5) after Ceist 4 and the Ceist 4A–4E Treoracha, under “N. B. Den bhfíorthábhacht é go mbeifeá ag machnamh i ngráid agus i gcéatadáin le linn na marcála. (Féach an scéim ghrádaithe sa Cheapadóireacht ar lch. eile.) An freagra a ghrádú agus a chéatadánú i d’aigne i dtosach, ansin cinneadh ar an marc.” It names no question. It is carried as printed on the literature cards and never read for rows: 3A(i) Eolas 13, 3B(i) “Cur síos air” 10, 4F(i) “Léiriú ar an bpríomhthéama” 17 and 4F(ii) 8 stay one row each.

Glyphs: the reading answers’ list marks (PDF 16–21) are a Calibri-Bold glyph returned as U+2010 alone on its line and drawn as a dash bullet, read as “•” (76 marks); the SymbolMT bullets inside A 1(a)’s answer (PDF 16, U+F0B7) are read as “•”.
